name: Chesterfield Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Central Methodist Church. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required.

short_description: Derbyshire Dales Council allotment sites in Chesterfield area
image: and Eckington. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Chesterfield Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run garden within Queen's Park growing seasonal vegetables. Harvest shared among volunteers with surplus for local food banks. Open weekends during growing season.
